text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":12,"unit":"feet","kind":"count","span":"12 feet"},{"id":"q2","value":10,"unit":"feet","kind":"count","span":"10 feet"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"feet","kind":"count","span":"2 feet wide"}],"plan":[{"op":"add","args":["q3","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"the border runs along both sides of each dimension, so add the border width to itself to find the total amount each dimension shrinks by"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"subtract the total border reduction from the room length to get the inner carpet length"},{"op":"sub","args":["q2","s1"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract the total border reduction from the room width to get the inner carpet width"},{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s4","note":"multiply room length by room width to get the total room area"},{"op":"mul","args":["s2","s3"],"out":"s5","note":"multiply inner carpet length by inner carpet width to get the carpet area"},{"op":"sub","args":["s4","s5"],"out":"s6","note":"subtract the carpet area from the total room area to get the border area"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"area of the border around the carpet"},"dismissed":[]}
